Abstract#1: Title from tape container. Marked as unedited copy. Includes a class lead by Ken Jacobs, featuring reading and discussion of recent articles about the decline of New York life and industry. Lecture topics: Great Migration, history of unionization in the United States, de-industrialization, outsourcing of labor, globalization, rise of fascism in Italy, history of New York City, history of immigration to the United States, machismo, Black American culture in the 1990s, gun violence in the United States.

Abstract#1: Recording of a visit by Nicholas Ray to Ken's Intro to Cinema Course. Lecture topics include: cultural contexts for art and their relevance, evolution of slang and its impact on art interpretation, postmodernist and poststructuralist linguistics, Franz Kline, films of Nicholas Ray, Sergei Eisenstein, the Dynamic Square.

Abstract#1: Notes from tape container, "Track 1: continuation discussion, video projection of 'Freaks' (3/18/71); Stepchild of Mechanic music discussions (3/24/71). Track 2: Video - projection of Freaks (3/2/71)." Recording of a guided analysis of 'Freaks' for Ken's Cinema 121 class. Discussion topics include: early film cutting and editing techniques, emotional effect of lighting and sound in film, gender and sexuality in early film, representation of marginalized communities in early film, Sergei Eisenstein, memory, use of space and acoustics to effect sound in film.

Jacobs tells story of defacing subway posters with Jack Smith,

Title#1: Jacobs, Ken - The Impossible (Collective for Living Cinema)
Abstract#1: Talk by Ken Jacobs at the Collective for Living Cinema about The Impossible (a series of Nervous System performances.) Topics discussed include: TOM TOM THE PIPER'S SON, Hans Hoffman, 3D visuals and imagery. Also includes questions and feedback from the audience
Note#2: 00:00 Audio starts with a snippet of a news broadcast. It is between an interviewer and a 12-year-old boy who says he is high on marijuana. Another voice interrupts the interview to provide context regarding the interview and introduce the legal and medical debate around the use of marijuana. 00:35 Audio of discussion begins in the middle of a conversation. 02:30 Ken begins discussing Tom Tom the Piper's Son.
